Leona.build: In the early game, use Null-Magic Mantle to help you withstand her damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Leona's damage, but also consider the damage type of the enemy carry attacking while Leona holds you in place. Since Leona has high armor and physical damage is less effective, include penetration in your offensive items.
Leona.combo: Before the fight, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. On entry, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Leona when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and if there's no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is her only mobility tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Watch for the risk of being locked down by Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare, and check for allied support before using Pantheon W Shield Vault. From farther away, you can join the fight in that opening with Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Leona.fight: Counterattack after Leona's engage abilities are down and you have left the range of Leona W Eclipse. Before going in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, check whether Leona E Zenith Blade is available and where your allies are. Once you're fighting, face Leona while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage.
Leona.laning: Make use of Pantheon's early strength, but don't trade using only physical damage into Leona's high armor. Chip away at her health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and build your passive with short casts. Line up an angle through the brush, but go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault only after Leona's engage abilities are down.
Leona.phase: Make use of Pantheon's base stats and short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts early, but poke first while accounting for Leona's high armor. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later as items stack, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Leona.teamfight: Leona P Sunlight appearing on you signals that the enemy is about to deal damage, so back off immediately. After your team lands crowd control, push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then get onto an enemy priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a spot with vision and time the landing with your team's crowd control.
Leona.watch: Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so watch the distance at which she can reach you rather than whether she has used the ability. When Leona W Eclipse is active, move outside its range before it explodes, and move to the side when Leona R Solar Flare's indicator appears to avoid the stun in the center.

Aatrox.fight: Look for a trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. After Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When Aatrox retaliates, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward him. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, don't engage; create distance instead.
Aatrox.teamfight: After an ally's crowd control lands, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward the enemy to block frontal damage as you push in, then lock down a priority damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot where you have vision and time it with your allies' crowd control. You have no way to disengage after Pantheon W Shield Vault, so don't go in alone first.
Aatrox.escape: Right after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Check whether Aatrox W Infernal Chains is down too before going in to reduce the risk of being pulled. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check for allied support and whether Aatrox has used his mobility spell before committing.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Aatrox heals through Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender, so get Executioner's Calling early too. Aatrox has relatively high armor, so add penetration to increase your damage.
Aatrox.combo: Before a trade, fully stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Keep Pantheon E Aegis Assault aimed at Aatrox and end it early once the attack you need to block is over.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at Aatrox's health, and look for an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault when he focuses on last-hitting or just after he uses a counterattack spell. Approaching is dangerous, so use the brush to set up an angle and avoid reckless engages that could give up an early kill.
Aatrox.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, but giving Aatrox a kill can let him snowball quickly, so build your lead carefully. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous if its blade tip hits you, so when you see the cast, move inside or outside its range. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately to avoid being pulled.

Kled.combo: The standard sequence is Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Build Pantheon P Mortal Will before the fight, and if you need to block Kled's frontal counterattack, face him while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. If there's no more damage to block, end Pantheon E Aegis Assault early and move to your next action.
Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Armor can't block the damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and consider tenacity if you die while locked down by crowd control.
Kled.escape: Don't engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; look for a window when Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is unavailable too. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use the movement speed from Pantheon E Aegis Assault to create distance before it pulls you in. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check Kled's mobility and the location of allied support before going in.
Kled.fight: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will ahead of time with a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or Kled E Jousting is down and he has fewer ways to counterattack. If Kled counterattacks, face him while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Kled.laning: Poke with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, and line up an engage through the brush while Kled focuses on last-hitting. When Kled is dismounted from Skaarl, watch his courage bar and create distance if you can't secure the kill. After dismounting him, push him out of lane so he can't build courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so use short Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke to gain an advantage in lane. The data indicates both champions become weaker later, so use your early lead without claiming either has the upper hand in the late-game matchup.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks since Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from outside vision. If you can't stop his engage, use the fact that he charges the first champion in his path: have an allied tank stand in front and keep your formation. After your team lands crowd control, lock down a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off to avoid the fourth basic attack, which deals damage proportional to maximum health, then go back in.

Bard.laning: Set up an angle in the brush and poke with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down and he focuses on last-hitting, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If you see Bard W Caretaker's Shrine, walk over it to destroy it.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Watch the flanks because Bard E Magical Journey can bring him in from the side. If you enter Bard R Tempered Fate's area, time your engage around the period when you can't deal damage.
Bard.build: Bard deals mostly magic damage, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads. Bard can heal with Bard W Caretaker's Shrine, so pick up Executioner's Calling early too.
Bard.combo: Before a trade, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. After Bard E Magical Journey and Bard Q Cosmic Binding are down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Bard and end it early once there is no more damage to block.
Bard.escape: If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Follow Bard through a portal only if you judge it safe.
Bard.fight: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down and right after Bard uses Bard E Magical Journey. Before engaging, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. You can't get out after using Pantheon W Shield Vault, so check for allied support before going in.
Bard.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, so keep poking with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to build a lead. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Bard.teamfight: After an ally's crowd control lands, lock down a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then push in while Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks incoming frontal damage. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot where you have vision and time it with your allies' crowd control. Also account for the time a target is immune to damage from Bard R Tempered Fate when you engage.

Olaf.phase: Both champions are strong early, so harass with Pantheon Q Comet Spear without giving Olaf a kill. Olaf gets relatively weaker later, but Pantheon also falls behind in damage and durability, so make use of your early lead.
Olaf.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don’t rely on armor alone; get health too. Consider lowering his attack speed to take fewer basic attacks.
Olaf.combo: Build your passive with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks before a fight. When Olaf R Ragnarok is not active, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing him → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. End E early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block.
Olaf.escape: Your opening comes when Olaf Q Undertow is down and he can’t retrieve the axe. Right after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, you can close in and stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, but Pantheon can’t escape with W after using it to engage, so check for allied support.
Olaf.fight: Trade briefly when Olaf Q Undertow is down and he can’t easily retrieve the axe. Build your passive before closing in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and don’t engage expecting a stun while Olaf R Ragnarok is active. When Olaf retaliates, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing him.
Olaf.laning: Chip away at his health with a long cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for an opening when Olaf focuses on last-hitting or just after he uses Q Undertow. Move to the opposite side from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so approach along the brush and check for allied support before going in.
Olaf.teamfight: Join your allies with Pantheon R Grand Starfall in time with their crowd control, or go in alongside them and lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t use W’s stun on him; create distance and wait for it to end. When you need to block Olaf’s frontal damage, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing him.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces your armor, so move to the opposite side from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault won’t work, so create distance and use W after it ends. Olaf attacks faster and heals more at low health, so don’t recklessly engage just because he’s at half health.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo’s P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t try to stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault while his passive is available. Dr. Mundo’s Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health, so stay behind minions, especially while your health is high. If Dr. Mundo has activated R Maximum Dosage, account for its healing and movement speed increase; don’t spend too long trying to kill him.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper makes fights drag on, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is still available, first use another immobilizing effect from an ally to draw it out, then use Pantheon W Shield Vault. If you built Pantheon P Mortal Will before the fight, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and Q Infected Bonesaw misses or is blocked by a minion. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check the positions of allies who can support you before using it.
DrMundo.fight: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault just after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and Q Infected Bonesaw misses or is blocked by a minion. Face Dr. Mundo with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and if there are no more attacks to block, end it early to continue with your next attack. Don’t force a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available.
DrMundo.laning: Chip away at his health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, then use a bush to find an engage angle after Dr. Mundo focuses on last-hitting and uses Q Infected Bonesaw. Normally, keep a minion between you and Dr. Mundo to block Q Infected Bonesaw. After a trade, if there is a canister Dr. Mundo dropped, step on it as you retreat to stop his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead by poking with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind late game, so play to finish the game with your early lead.
DrMundo.teamfight: If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, shift your efforts to another objective instead of spending time trying to kill him. After your allies’ crowd control lands, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down a priority enemy target, then push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in a spot with vision and time your arrival with your allies.

Quinn.watch: Quinn’s E Vault knocks back Pantheon’s engage, slows him, and leaves a mark, so don’t force an approach before it’s used. If Quinn’s P Harrier marks you, move out of her basic attack range and let the mark expire. Stand behind the minion line to make Quinn’s Q Blinding Assault hit a minion first.
Quinn.build: Prioritize armor from your first purchase. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so armor is more effective than magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: Fully stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks before a fight. When Quinn E Vault is down, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her only escape tool, so right after she uses it is your window to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check the position of allied support before going in.
Quinn.fight: Right after Quinn E Vault is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault for a short trade. After engaging, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Quinn to block frontal damage, and end it early once there’s no more damage to block.
Quinn.laning: Early on, preserve your health and collect CS outside Quinn’s range, and stand behind the minion line to reduce the angle for Quinn Q Blinding Assault. Harass with a long cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for an opening when Quinn E Vault is down and she’s focused on last-hitting. Approach along the brush, but don’t force an engage without help from your allied jungler.
Quinn.phase: Pantheon is strong early, but Quinn’s range pushes him back, so preserve your health and look for an opening when Quinn E Vault is down. Later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to end the game.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn comes in from the flank, stun her with Pantheon W Shield Vault and aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward the incoming frontal damage. Don’t dive in alone; engage in time with your allies’ crowd control.

Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc’s Q Handshake catches you, she chooses the direction to throw you, and it can stun an ally too, so avoid it from behind minions or your frontline. While Renata Glasc’s R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies; if it hits you, immediately use a crowd-control cleanse or move away from them. Enemies affected by Renata Glasc’s W Bailout keep fighting briefly after going down, so make sure no ally dies near them.
Renata.build: Renata Glasc's damage is mostly magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resist, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Get Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Renata Glasc W Bailout.
Renata.combo: After building your passive, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Renata when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move on to your next action if there's no more damage to block.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no innate mobility, so when Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, you have a chance to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check for ally support before pressing it. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, engage while keeping your distance from allies.
Renata.fight: Renata Glasc has no innate mobility, so close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and burst her briefly right after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. Dodge Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program sideways, and aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Renata to block frontal damage.
Renata.laning: Use Pantheon's early strength to find an approach angle from the brush, and throw a charged Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at Renata's health. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Renata is focused on last-hitting and Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. Before trading, build your passive with a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks on minions.
Renata.phase: Pantheon is strong early, while Renata Glasc has relatively low base stats, so pressure Renata herself. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later as items build, so use the lead you've built to finish the game.
Renata.teamfight: Engage while keeping your distance from allies as long as Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available. After your allies apply crowd control, lock down Renata or another priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a spot with vision and time your landing with your allies' crowd control.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s Q Bloodlust heals him, so get Executioner’s Calling early. Tryndamere’s main damage is physical and relies on critical strikes, so prioritize armor. Thornmail is also an option against Tryndamere, who relies on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.combo: After Tryndamere uses E Spinning Slash, stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Tryndamere while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. If Tryndamere activates R Undying Rage, don’t deal more damage with a combo; wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after you make Tryndamere use E Spinning Slash is your chance to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Tryndamere’s W Mocking Shout is also down, you can engage without worrying about its slow. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for ally support and Tryndamere’s mobility spell before using it.
Tryndamere.fight: Whittle down his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, but engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault just after Tryndamere’s E Spinning Slash is used. Face Tryndamere and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front; once there’s nothing left to block, end it early and move on to your next action.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, poke with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts to stop Tryndamere from building Fury by last-hitting. Before a fight, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Q casts and basic attacks on minions. Back off when Tryndamere starts building Fury, and walk backward while facing him to avoid Tryndamere’s W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere’s P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes dangerous as his Fury builds, so keep your distance while he attacks minions to build it. Tryndamere’s E Spinning Slash cooldown is reduced whenever he critically strikes, so he can keep using it in a minion wave. When Tryndamere activates R Undying Rage, he can’t die, so instead of dealing more damage, pin him with Pantheon W Shield Vault or keep your distance and wait it out.
Tryndamere.phase: Use Pantheon’s strong base stats and short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke and build a lead early. As items accumulate, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Tryndamere.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, engage on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them. If Tryndamere is in a side lane with R Undying Rage ready, don’t go stop him alone; send more players or trade for an objective.

Akali.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Akali.combo: Before a trade, fully stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Check Akali's mobility spells, then trade with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Akali, and end it early once there is no more damage to block.
Akali.escape: If only one mobility spell is down, Akali can still escape with her remaining mobility abilities, so check them first. Close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall, especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: After Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, check whether she still has another mobility spell. When you can get in range, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Akali.laning: Poke with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to fully stack your passive and create an early health and CS lead. When Akali focuses on last-hitting and her counterattack spell is down, use the brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to influence other lanes. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use the lead you built early to close out the game.
Akali.teamfight: After an ally's crowd control lands, engage on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and keep them locked down. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block incoming frontal damage. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where you have vision and time your arrival with your allies.

Alistar.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Alistar's magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads. Alistar P Triumphant Roar heals him, so pick up Executioner's Calling early. Add penetration to account for Alistar's high armor.
Alistar.combo: Before a trade, fully stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Alistar and end it early once there is no more damage to block.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his only mobility spell, so right after you bait it out is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check your allies' positions before going in.
Alistar.fight: Right after Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal a quick burst of damage. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't use all your spells; back off and fight again after it ends.
Alistar.laning: Use long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at Alistar's health, and look for an engage when he focuses on last-hitting. Use the brush to approach, but only use Pantheon W Shield Vault after Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down. While both spells are down, push the lane or reposition.
Alistar.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, so keep poking with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to build a lead. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Alistar.teamfight: Don't spend too long hitting Alistar; target the damage dealers behind him. After an ally's crowd control lands, engage on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Pantheon W Shield Vault's stun still works while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, so if you can't back off, use it to interrupt the engage.
Alistar.watch: It's dangerous to get hit by both Alistar Q Pulverize's knock-up and Alistar W Headbutt's displacement. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you, and approach only after both spells are down.

Aurora.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand her damage and choose Mercury's Treads. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Pick up Executioner's Calling early too, so healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration doesn't cost you a kill opportunity.
Aurora.combo: Before a trade, fully stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Aurora, and end it early once there is no more damage to block so you can move on to your next action.
Aurora.escape: Don't engage just because Aurora E The Weirding is down; check Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora R Between Worlds too. In particular, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault during the window when her mobility spells are down, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. If Aurora is stealthed with Aurora W Across the Veil, don't rush a targeted engage; wait until she becomes visible again.
Aurora.fight: Chip away at Aurora's health with Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then take a short trade right after her counterattack spell is down. Pantheon W Shield Vault is your only engage tool, so check not just Aurora E The Weirding but also Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora R Between Worlds before using it. If health has decreased while Aurora Q Twofold Hex's curse is applied, don't let the trade drag on.
Aurora.laning: Use Pantheon's early strength to poke with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and fully stack your passive. Before closing in, hold Pantheon Q Comet Spear to throw it and chip away at health, then set up an angle in the brush and look for when she focuses on last-hitting. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault only right after one of Aurora's counterattack spells is down.
Aurora.phase: Early game is Pantheon's strong window, when his base stats and short-tap Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke are effective. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Aurora.teamfight: After an ally's crowd control lands, lock down a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then push in while Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks incoming frontal damage. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, coordinate with your team's formation and timing. If Aurora jumps in and fails to kill anyone, look for a chance to catch her; when backing off, don't leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse is recalled, and that damage increases the more health you've lost. If you're cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, back off before the recall. You'll be slowed if you leave the area after Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, so decide whether to get out before the zone appears.

Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Prioritize magic resistance to counter the magic damage from Blitzcrank's main damage spells, Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Magic resistance doesn't block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.combo: Before a trade, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward incoming damage, and end it early once there is no more to block so you can move on to your next action.
Blitzcrank.escape: Look for an engage when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he runs out of mana. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so before going in, check for the crowd control that can follow from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field, as well as allied support. When you have an opening, close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he lacks mana. Chip away at his health with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when he focuses on last-hitting. Check for allied support before going in, and face the direction damage is coming from when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Blitzcrank.laning: Don't stand beside the minions; stand behind them to block the path of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Use a Control Ward to secure vision in the brush, and keep your distance from brush you can't see into. Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, push the lane or take a favorable trade.
Blitzcrank.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so poke with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to build a lead. In the late game, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Instead of spending too long on Blitzcrank, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down a priority target behind him. Engage after an ally's crowd control lands, and push in while Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks incoming frontal damage. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot where you have vision and time it with your allies' crowd control.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so keep minions in front of you and dodge it. If it pulls you in, it can be followed by Blitzcrank E Power Fist's knock-up and Blitzcrank R Static Field's silence, so don't approach near brush you can't see. Even after Blitzcrank's health drops, Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier can activate, so save something to finish him off.

Brand.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Pantheon has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Brand.combo: Before a trade, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spell, so treat the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down as your engage signal. If you're ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear's stun before engaging, and account for the fact that Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape.
Brand.fight: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, engage on Brand with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If you aren't ablaze, Brand Q Sear can't stun you, so use that moment for a short trade.
Brand.laning: Don't last-hit next to a burning minion, and sidestep if the wave is grouped together. Chip away at Brand's health with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then use the brush to set up an engage right after he focuses on last-hitting and uses a counterattack spell.
Brand.phase: In the mid game, maintain the lead you built early. In the late game, as items stack up, Pantheon's damage and durability fall behind, so look to close out the game early.
Brand.teamfight: Brand E Conflagration spreads around burning targets, and Brand R Pyroclasm bounces between enemies, so spread out from allies before engaging and don't stand next to a burning ally. After an ally's crowd control lands, lock down Brand with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Brand to block frontal damage.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, Brand Q Sear stuns you, so while you're ablaze, move out of the projectile's path or stand behind a minion. Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame first, and spread out from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm.

Braum.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Braum’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Braum.combo: Before fighting, briefly tap Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave in basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will. On entry, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Braum E Unbreakable is active, start the combo after his shield drops or you get an angle from the side.
Braum.escape: Right after you force Braum to use W Stand Behind Me is your chance to close the gap. Check the threat from Braum Q Winter’s Bite and Braum R Glacial Fissure, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check the positions of allies who can support you before going in.
Braum.fight: If Braum E Unbreakable is active, don’t throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear; wait until his shield drops or you can line up an angle from the side. Once Braum W Stand Behind Me and his means of counterattacking are down, close in on the ally he is protecting with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If you need to take counterattack damage, face the opponent with Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to block the straight path of Braum Q Winter’s Bite, and don’t stand in front of him when there’s a gap between minions. Use bushes to find an approach angle, and chip away at his health with a long Pantheon Q Comet Spear when Braum E Unbreakable is down. When the opponent focuses on last-hitting and their counterattack ability is down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Braum.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead by poking with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind late game, so play to finish the game with your early lead.
Braum.teamfight: Don’t pour damage into the front of Braum E Unbreakable or keep hitting Braum; find a path to reach the damage dealer he is protecting. Avoid the straight path of Braum R Glacial Fissure, then use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down a priority target after your allies’ crowd control lands. If joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in a spot with vision and time your arrival with your allies.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter’s Bite or a basic attack hits you and applies Braum P Concussive Blows’ mark, move out of range before the stun triggers. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast animation and dodge sideways out of its straight path; don’t step into the slowing zone it leaves behind.

Camille.build: Build armor first to prepare for Camille’s main damage. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health, so be careful about relying on stacking health. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing keeps costing you kill opportunities, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early.
Camille.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear thrusts and basic attacks. Face Camille with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early if there is no more damage to block.
Camille.escape: The moment Camille E Hookshot’s stun and mobility are down is your chance to engage. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still on cooldown, close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check Camille’s remaining mobility and your allies’ support before going in.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; fight after the shield has been removed. When Camille E Hookshot is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and face Camille with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to take the counterattack damage. Creating distance while waiting for Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered attack is also effective.
Camille.laning: Poke with Pantheon Q Comet Spear early to take lane control and pressure Camille’s farming before she completes her first core item. Stay away from walls and watch for the long engage range of Camille E Hookshot. When Camille focuses on last-hitting and her counterattack ability is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Camille.phase: Pantheon is strong early, while Camille is weak before her first core item, so build lane control and a farming lead during this window. After learning Pantheon R Grand Starfall, affect other lanes too. From midgame onward, Camille can quickly destroy turrets in a side lane, so don’t leave a side lane unattended. Use your early lead before Pantheon falls off late game.
Camille.teamfight: Use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down an enemy damage dealer in sync with your allies’ crowd control. During your engage, face the direction the damage is coming from with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with your allies’ crowd control.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot lets her engage from long range using a wall and stun you, so stay away from walls to avoid it. Part of Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered attack deals true damage, so create distance while she prepares it or face Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Camille to block the damage. Crowd control does not work during Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum’s entry, so don’t use Pantheon W Shield Vault at that moment.

Chogath.build: Cho’Gath mainly deals magic damage, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early to counter Cho’Gath P Carnivore’s healing. Resistance can block the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast.
Chogath.combo: Before fighting, briefly tap Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave in basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will. Once Cho’Gath Q Rupture is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to the next action.
Chogath.escape: Engage after dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture or after he uses it on the wave, and after avoiding the front of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in. If you are at or below half health, beware of the true damage from Cho’Gath R Feast and don’t fight at close range.
Chogath.fight: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after dodging Cho’Gath Q Rupture sideways or right after he uses it on the wave. Avoid the front of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Cho’Gath to block damage coming from the front.
Chogath.laning: Pressure him from early on by building Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. Look for an engage when Cho’Gath focuses on last-hitting or just after he uses Cho’Gath Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so pressure the lane and don’t give Cho’Gath room to stack. Pantheon falls behind as time passes while Cho’Gath grows stronger with stacks, so keep building on your early lead.
Chogath.teamfight: After your allies’ crowd control lands, close in on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing the direction the damage is coming from. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with your allies’ crowd control.
Chogath.watch: Cho’Gath Q Rupture knocks you airborne after a warning appears beneath you, so dodge sideways as soon as you see the mark. Cho’Gath W Feral Scream applies silence from the front, making the follow-up Cho’Gath Q Rupture harder to dodge, so stay out of his frontal line. If you are at or below half health, watch the range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage, and create distance.

Darius.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early because of the healing from Darius Q Decimate. Build armor against Darius P Hemorrhage and his Q Decimate and W Crippling Strike, but also get health to account for the penetration from Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from R Noxian Guillotine. Darius tends to have high armor, so consider penetration for Pantheon’s physical damage.
Darius.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Darius E Apprehend is down. After landing, use an empowered basic attack, Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Darius with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early if there are no more attacks to block.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend has missed or is on cooldown. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support and the status of Darius E Apprehend before using it.
Darius.fight: Long fights favor Darius Q Decimate’s healing and Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, so trade briefly and back off. After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Dodge the blade of Darius Q Decimate or stay close to him to take the hit. Back off before the bleed stacks build up, let them expire, then fight again.
Darius.laning: Poke with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear throws from outside Darius E Apprehend’s range. When Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions or E Apprehend is down, use a bush to find an angle and close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault as he goes to last-hit. Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks.
Darius.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, but Darius is also strong in early skirmishes, so build a lead with short trades. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind late game, so play to finish the game using the advantage you built early.
Darius.teamfight: After your allies’ crowd control lands, close in on the enemy’s key damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a spot with vision and time your landing with your allies’ crowd control. If several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage have built up and health has dropped, move out of range to avoid being killed by Darius R Noxian Guillotine and triggering chained damage.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you will take follow-up attacks, so poke from outside its range and look for an opening right after it misses. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to let them expire. If health has dropped while the stacks remain, move out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s range.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Healing from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge can erase a kill opportunity during a fight, so fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early.
Fiora.combo: After confirming Fiora W Riposte is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Pantheon P Mortal Will is ready, land an empowered basic attack, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Fiora, then finish with a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Fiora.escape: Right after making Fiora use Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault, but this ability cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before using it.
Fiora.fight: After Fiora W Riposte is down, use the moment she comes in with Fiora Q Lunge as an opportunity for a short trade. Face Fiora with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and don’t chase recklessly after the trade ends.
Fiora.laning: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. Poke with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, then look for an opening when Fiora focuses on last-hitting and Fiora W Riposte is down.
Fiora.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so build a lead by poking with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall to block a vital on one side. After your allies’ crowd control lands, close in on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time your arrival with your allies’ crowd control.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte can block the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault and stun Pantheon in return, so don’t leap while Riposte is available. Fiora Q Lunge can bring her in toward a vital, so stand opposite the vital to narrow her angle.

Gangplank.build: Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps poking you, so build armor early, starting in lane. If healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy keeps costing you kill opportunities, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so build some health as well.
Gangplank.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to the next action.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window right after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg and while Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down is a good time to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Don’t engage if there is a primed barrel nearby. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in.
Gangplank.fight: Trade right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, when there are no primed barrels nearby. Before closing in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, check whether Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down so your stun and focused damage will stick. Once you engage, face Gangplank with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage coming from the front.
Gangplank.laning: Poke with Pantheon Q Comet Spear early and use bushes to find an engage angle when Gangplank focuses on last-hitting. Back off if a nearby Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and close in right after he places a new one. If Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps chipping away at your health, build armor early.
Gangplank.phase: Use Pantheon’s early strength to build a lead during the window before Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind late game, so play to finish the game with your early lead.
Gangplank.teamfight: Use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down the enemy’s key damage dealer in sync with your allies’ crowd control. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to face Gangplank and block frontal damage from him. If joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time your arrival with your allies’ engage.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg is a threat because it applies a slow, so don’t go near a primed barrel or a spot where two barrels overlap. If you can destroy a barrel from outside its explosion range, do so, and look to fight right after he places one. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy removes stuns and restores health, so check whether he has used it before going for a kill with Pantheon W Shield Vault.

Garen.build: Fit Executioner’s Calling into your build early to counter healing from Garen P Perseverance. Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment, but also consider health because resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice.
Garen.combo: Start after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage’s brief shield and tenacity window has passed. Build your passive in advance, then use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility, so the chance to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault comes after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence is down and Garen W Courage’s brief tenacity window ends. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly right after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used. If you see Garen W Courage’s activation animation, delay Pantheon W Shield Vault by half a beat. While Garen E Judgment is spinning, face Garen with Pantheon E Aegis Assault and move out of the spin’s range.
Garen.laning: Poke with Pantheon Q Comet Spear early and look for an engage angle when Garen focuses on last-hitting. Be careful not to approach first when Garen is in a bush and take all the damage from his spin. Push the lane to limit Garen’s opportunity to build growth stacks, then create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so pressure Garen with poke and short trades. In midgame, use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to affect other lanes and extend your early gains. Late game, Garen’s Garen W Courage growth stacks build up while Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind, so play to finish the game early with your lead.
Garen.teamfight: After your allies’ crowd control lands, close in on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault facing the direction the frontal damage is coming from. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time your landing with your allies.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack applies silence, so don’t approach him first while it is active. Don’t stay in the area of Garen E Judgment’s spin for long, and if you are below half health, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to account for Gnar’s main damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on the target’s maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. Consider tenacity in fights where Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into a wall.
Gnar.combo: When engaging, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack with Pantheon P Mortal Will → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Gnar, and end it early once there’s no more frontal damage to block.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Crunch is Gnar’s only mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your opening to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Hold off while Mega Gnar’s crowd control is a threat, and look to fight during the window after Mega Gnar returns to Mini Gnar and before he can transform again. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Gnar.fight: Right after Mini Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch, close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Once close, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Gnar to block his frontal counterattack. When there’s no more damage to block, end it early and follow up with your next attack. Right after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, create distance and let time pass.
Gnar.laning: Use brush to approach from an angle and chip away at Gnar with a long Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Mini Gnar focuses on last-hitting and Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks on minions.
Gnar.phase: Early on, use Pantheon’s strong base stats and short Pantheon Q Comet Spear to harass. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain so Gnar R GNAR! can’t knock and stun you into one. Open a fight with your team right after Mega Gnar ends and he returns to Mini Gnar. Use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to an area with vision, timed with allied crowd control, then block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault and stick to a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit on both the way out and the way back, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns on wall impact, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. When Gnar is close to transforming, avoid a direct fight and wait for Mega Gnar to end.

Gwen.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early on. Pick up Executioner’s Calling early to counter healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts, and mix in penetration to deal with Gwen’s high armor. Later, consider magic resistance items such as Spectre’s Cowl, but dodge the true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by repositioning.
Gwen.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will to empower Pantheon W Shield Vault. From a position where Gwen W Hallowed Mist won’t prevent you from targeting her, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. End Pantheon E Aegis Assault early and move to your next action when there’s no more damage to block.
Gwen.escape: Right after baiting out Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is your chance to close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, enter the mist or wait for it to end before using Pantheon W Shield Vault. Since Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, check Gwen’s mobility and allied support before engaging.
Gwen.fight: Bait out Gwen E Skip ’n Slash, then check your position before engaging so you don’t waste Pantheon W Shield Vault outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist. Face Gwen when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and sidestep the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.laning: Usually, harass with Pantheon Q Comet Spear from outside Gwen’s basic attack range, and build your passive with basic attacks on minions and short Pantheon Q Comet Spears. While Gwen is focused on last-hitting, use brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault immediately after she uses her counterattack ability. Gwen E Skip ’n Slash becomes available again quickly around many minions, so don’t force an attempt to keep her pinned down there.
Gwen.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so build a lead with harassment and short trades before Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks up. After learning Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in areas with vision to impact other lanes as well. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Gwen.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault facing Gwen to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with allied crowd control. The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! can’t be blocked with resistances, so sidestep it even during a teamfight.
Gwen.watch: The center of the cone of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so sidestep when she casts it. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so use Pantheon W Shield Vault from inside it or after it ends.

Heimerdinger.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early on. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic damage, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Heimerdinger.combo: Before fighting, use short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will. When engaging, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Heimerdinger when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action when there’s no more damage to block.
Heimerdinger.escape: Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support and turret positions before engaging.
Heimerdinger.fight: Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks only damage from the direction you’re facing, so aim it toward your opponent. Avoid fights surrounded by turrets from multiple directions.
Heimerdinger.laning: If it’s hard to break through Heimerdinger’s turret setup and kill him, focus on another lane instead of staying tied to this one.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Pantheon has strong base stats and can keep harassing with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: After an ally lands crowd control, stick to a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot in an area with allied wards and time it with allied crowd control. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don’t group up and contest in a narrow area in front of an objective.

Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early on. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks. Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then use an empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the key condition for engaging is whether Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Then close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall, but check for allied support too since Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to harass or clear the wave, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault for a short trade. When taking return damage, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Hwei.
Hwei.laning: Chip away at Hwei with a long Pantheon Q Comet Spear and use brush to approach from an angle. Even if Hwei is focused on last-hitting, wait until Hwei E Subject: Torment is down before engaging with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Hwei.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so widen your lead while Hwei’s counterattack ability is down. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later as items build, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Hwei.teamfight: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down or an ally lands crowd control, lock Hwei down with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Face Hwei and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, time your landing with your team.
Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can root or displace you and set up more damage, so don’t engage first while it’s available. If Hwei hits you with his first ability, move immediately to avoid his second ability and the detonation from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Illaoi.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early to counter healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God. Build armor first against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Illaoi.combo: After Illaoi E Test of Spirit misses and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Illaoi while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage, and end it early to move to your next action when there’s nothing more to block.
Illaoi.escape: Engage after Illaoi E Test of Spirit is down and immediately after she uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, her only mobility tool. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check tentacle positions and allied support before engaging. Use Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall when you need to close the gap.
Illaoi.fight: The opening to engage is after Illaoi E Test of Spirit misses and immediately after she uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Fight in open ground away from walls with tentacles, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and deal your damage in a short burst. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith is used, create distance during that damage window.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. Chip away at her with thrown Pantheon Q Comet Spears, then use brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault after Illaoi focuses on last-hitting and uses her counterattack ability. Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks.
Illaoi.phase: Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi; when Illaoi R Leap of Faith is used, spread out and wait out her brief damage window. Destroy tentacles if you can, or pull Illaoi into open ground away from walls if you can’t. After an ally lands crowd control, push in while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, then lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, it pulls out your spirit, so stay out of range while last-hitting and move after it misses. Near tentacles, watch out for healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God and Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is used, create distance during the brief window when her damage is concentrated.

Irelia.build: Irelia Q Bladesurge heals, so buy Executioner’s Calling early. The provided information isn’t enough to determine which resistance to build.
Irelia.combo: Before fighting, use short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks to prepare Pantheon P Mortal Will. Once Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Irelia.escape: Right after baiting out Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Check that Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down before going in. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check the opponent’s mobility and allied support positions before using it.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, if Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and burst her briefly. To block return damage, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Irelia, and end it early once there’s nothing left to block.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and step back when minions are about to die. Use brush to set up an angle to engage, but go in only after Irelia’s counterattack ability is down.
Irelia.phase: Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize Irelia. After an ally lands crowd control, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Irelia to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot near allies with vision and time your arrival with their crowd control.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close in, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Janna.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Janna’s damage, and buy a Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Janna R Monsoon’s healing can erase a kill opportunity during a fight, so get Executioner’s Calling early too.
Janna.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks. If Janna creates distance but remains within range at low health, finish her with a thrown Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Janna.escape: Right after Janna Q Howling Gale is down is your chance to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, check whether she uses it since it could knock you back, and if possible, fight with your back to a wall. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before using it.
Janna.fight: After Janna Q Howling Gale is down and Janna E Eye Of The Storm’s shield is gone, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Face Janna when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and end it early to follow up with your next attack when there’s no more damage to block. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, account for the chance that it could knock you back before engaging.
Janna.laning: Chip away at her with a long Pantheon Q Comet Spear and use brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pressure an ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look for an opening after the shield is gone. Bait Janna into wasting Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr to make it easier to take control of the lane.
Janna.phase: Early on, use Pantheon’s base stats and short Pantheon Q Comet Spear to apply pressure. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna stays behind an allied damage dealer, your engage will be knocked back, so get vision and look for a moment when she’s isolated. After an ally lands crowd control, lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in an area with vision and time it with allied crowd control.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can knock Pantheon up and interrupt his engage, so if you hear a tornado from out of vision, avoid its path. Don’t unload all your damage at once on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Check whether Janna R Monsoon has been used, since it can knock away an engaging Pantheon and heal nearby allies.

Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for his damage, so consider attack speed reduction first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t focus on only one resistance. Jax E Counter Strike scales with maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spears and basic attacks. Once Jax E Counter Strike ends, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack immediately after landing → Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing your opponent → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Jax.escape: After avoiding the stun from Jax E Counter Strike, the moment right after Jax Q Leap Strike is also used is your window to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check Jax’s mobility and allied support positions before engaging.
Jax.fight: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, build Pantheon P Mortal Will and engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so don’t force an engage.
Jax.phase: Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your lead to close out the game.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group up around him; wait out its duration and stun, then focus your crowd control on him. Pantheon should use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down a key target after allied crowd control and Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are dodged and its recast can stun you, so stop using basic attacks and move out of range. Don’t force a fight when Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike or when Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms increases his armor.

Jayce.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast.
Jayce.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will before the fight. On entry, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Jayce.escape: Jayce Q To the Skies! is his only mobility tool, so right after baiting out that leap is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is down too, then go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before you engage.
Jayce.fight: After the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow are down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Before trading, use a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will and decide which ability to empower. Once close, face Jayce when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to take damage from the front.
Jayce.laning: When Jayce has his cannon, expect ranged poke and move side to side while last-hitting. Use the brush to line up a long Pantheon Q Comet Spear and chip away at his health, then go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Jayce's counterattack abilities are down and he is focused on last-hitting. If you fall behind early, farm defensively instead of forcing a comeback.
Jayce.phase: Both champions are strong early, so don't take a forced fight after losing health to Jayce's poke. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later as items stack, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for the moment after Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is down and he has no mobility, then lock him down with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Face the direction the incoming damage will come from when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and engage after your team lands crowd control. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with your team's crowd control.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce E Acceleration Gate is placed, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks only damage from the direction Pantheon is facing, so use it while facing Jayce.

Karma.build: Karma's main damage is magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Karma W empowered by Karma R Mantra becomes a problem in fights, fit in Executioner's Calling early.
Karma.combo: While Karma W Focused Resolve is down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault and use an empowered basic attack, Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Karma when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and if there's no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Karma.escape: Don't go in first with Pantheon W Shield Vault while Karma W Focused Resolve is available. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before using it.
Karma.fight: Go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield ends. Delay your burst immediately after Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra shields nearby allies. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, face Karma and take damage from the front.
Karma.laning: Chip away at Karma's health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, and line up Pantheon W Shield Vault from the brush while she focuses on last-hitting. Go in only right after Karma's counterattack abilities are down. Before trading, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks on minions.
Karma.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, so use short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts to poke and build a lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Karma.teamfight: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra ends, go onto a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Don't engage alone: go in with your team's crowd control, or use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to land with your team at a spot with vision.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows, and the area from Karma Q empowered by Karma R Mantra explodes again after a short delay. If it hits you, walk out of the circle immediately; otherwise, stand behind minions or outside its range to reduce the chance of being hit. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.

Kayle.build: In the early game, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Kayle's magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kayle W Celestial Blessing's healing can erase Pantheon's kill window, so fit in Executioner's Calling early. It's also important to dodge direct hits from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which reduces your magic resistance.
Kayle.combo: Before the fight, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with a short Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. The standard engage is Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage and lock down the target with the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault, then attack again once the damage immunity ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no dash, but Kayle W Celestial Blessing boosts her movement speed and Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows. Right after Kayle Q Radiant Blast is down, stun her first with Pantheon W Shield Vault to reduce the chance she can escape with Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Pantheon W Shield Vault cannot be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in.
Kayle.fight: Right after Kayle Q Radiant Blast is down, approach through the brush, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and face Kayle when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is still available, don't use all your damage at once; attack again after the damage immunity ends.
Kayle.laning: Lower Kayle's health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, and line up Pantheon W Shield Vault while she focuses on last-hitting.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to Kayle from the flank or outside vision instead of spending time on the frontline. Time Pantheon W Shield Vault with your team's crowd control to lock her down, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault facing Kayle to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land with your team at a spot with vision and deal damage after Kayle R Divine Judgment's damage immunity ends.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so be careful about fighting right after it hits you. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on your missing health, so be especially wary when your health is low. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage and use the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault to keep the target locked down while waiting out the damage immunity.

Lulu.build: In the early game, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Lulu's magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Choose your later resistances based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting.
Lulu.combo: After confirming Lulu W Whimsy is down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Lulu while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and if there's no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to escape on her own, so look for the moment when Lulu W Whimsy, which can stop your engage, is down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check whether your allies can support you before using it.
