Lulu.fight: Go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Lulu W Whimsy is down. If Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield is on an ally and Lulu R Wild Growth is also unavailable, target Lulu herself, since she has no dash to escape.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Keep up steady poke with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, then line up an angle from the brush and engage when Lulu is focused on last-hitting and Lulu W Whimsy is down.
Lulu.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so use short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts to poke and build a lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Lulu.teamfight: If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu herself or someone else instead of the protected target. After your team lands crowd control, get onto a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land at a spot with vision and time your landing with your team.
Lulu.watch: If you go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault while Lulu W Whimsy is available, its silence and attack lockout will stop your engage. Lulu R Wild Growth immediately increases its target's health and knocks up nearby enemies, so while it is available, don't jump onto a protected target expecting a kill.

Lux.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Lux’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads, and prioritize magic resistance over armor afterward.
Lux.combo: Charge Pantheon P Mortal Will, dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. After landing, attack in this order: empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If there’s no more damage to block, end E early and move to your next action.
Lux.escape: A missed Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility spell to create distance, so close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall during that window. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in.
Lux.fight: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility spell to create distance, so deal a quick burst once you’re on her. Against damage coming from the front, face Lux and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Lux.laning: Chip away at Lux with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and look for an engage angle from a bush or the side when she focuses on last-hitting. Preload Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault only right after Lux Q Light Binding is down.
Lux.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early and can keep up the poke with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, so build a lead early. As items stack later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch everyone at once. After your allies apply crowd control, pin Lux down with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and block frontal damage coming from Lux’s direction with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, aim for a visible landing spot and time it with your allies’ crowd control.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, follow-up abilities are easy to land in succession, so bait it out, dodge, then move. Q can pass through the first ally and root the second target, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. Move out of Lux E Lucent Singularity’s area, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.

Malphite.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Malphite’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Against Malphite’s high armor, make use of Pantheon W Shield Vault’s max-health damage instead of stacking only armor penetration.
Malphite.combo: Before a fight, charge Pantheon P Mortal Will by using short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and weaving in basic attacks. Once Malphite P Granite Shield is broken and his counterattack ability is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Malphite.escape: Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check Malphite’s counterattack abilities and allied support before using it.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first and chip away at his actual health before engaging. Right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard or E Ground Slam is down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault while your passive is charged. Face Malphite when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front.
Malphite.laning: When you’re too far away to engage, poke with a thrown Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and look for an angle from a bush when Malphite focuses on last-hitting and his counterattack ability is down. Bring in a jungle gank during this window to slow Malphite’s growth.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up several of you at once, and counterattack right after it’s down. Land with Pantheon R Grand Starfall in time with your allies’ crowd control, or go in while blocking damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then pin down an enemy damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. You have no way out after Pantheon W Shield Vault, so don’t engage alone first.
Malphite.watch: Being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade right after it hits. Don’t fight up close before Malphite E Ground Slam is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted with crowd control, so when you don’t know where Malphite is, don’t stand close to your allies near walls or bushes.

Maokai.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance first against Maokai’s damage, and add Executioner’s Calling early to counter Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance’s dash ends, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Maokai with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Maokai.escape: The window to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault opens right after you make Maokai use W Twisted Advance. Don’t engage first while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready. In teamfights, watch out for Maokai R Nature’s Grasp as well, and go in after your allies apply crowd control.
Maokai.fight: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down and make a quick trade. Charge Pantheon P Mortal Will before the fight, and face Maokai when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Don’t keep poking with abilities and trigger Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing sooner.
Maokai.laning: Make use of Pantheon’s early strength, but don’t move into range near brush while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready. Watch for Maokai E Sapling Toss in bushes, and charge Pantheon P Mortal Will by using short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks on minions. Step forward for a quick trade once Maokai W Twisted Advance is down.
Maokai.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead while Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. Later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Maokai.teamfight: Repeatedly using abilities on Maokai brings Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing back sooner, so focus on pinning down an enemy damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. In open terrain, dodge Maokai R Nature’s Grasp perpendicular to its path, and engage after your allies apply crowd control. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in a visible spot in time with your allies.
Maokai.watch: Maokai is untargetable during the dash from Maokai W Twisted Advance, so don’t use Pantheon W Shield Vault or basic attacks before Maokai lands. Don’t enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has planted a sapling. If Maokai R Nature’s Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path. Be wary of roots when Maokai W Twisted Advance and R Nature’s Grasp are ready.

Milio.build: Survive Milio’s magic damage early with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads. If Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life’s healing erase kill opportunities during fights, add Executioner’s Calling early. Milio himself deals little damage, so choose your later resistances based on the enemy damage dealers’ damage types as well.
Milio.combo: Before a fight, charge Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Milio has low health and creates distance, finish him with a thrown Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Milio.escape: Engage during the window when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick, his only disengage tool, is down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support and the enemy’s position before using it. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is available, wait for him to use it before engaging.
Milio.fight: Right after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, engage on Milio with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal a quick burst. Face your opponent when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage coming from the front, and end it early to move to your next attack if there’s no more to block. Don’t fight the front line for long while Milio W Cozy Campfire has extended the enemy marksman’s range.
Milio.laning: Make use of Pantheon’s early strength by chipping away at Milio’s health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, and use bushes to find an engage angle. Preload Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and the enemy is focused on last-hitting, and pressure Milio’s mana with trades and wave control.
Milio.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so build a lead with poke and trades while taking control of the wave. Milio’s composition gets stronger over time while Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Milio.teamfight: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, pin Milio down first with Pantheon W Shield Vault to cut off the enemy team's sustain; he has no mobility and low defensive stats. Push in while blocking damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, but don’t engage alone first—time it with your allies’ crowd control. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, aim for a visible landing spot and time it with your allies.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so engaging with Pantheon W Shield Vault while Q is available can interrupt your engage. Delay front-line fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and has extended the enemy marksman’s range. Milio E Warm Hugs’ shield and Milio R Breath of Life’s healing also reduce your chances to secure a kill with a short attack.

Morgana.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Morgana’s damage is mostly magic and Pantheon has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Add Executioner’s Calling early if healing is extending fights.
Morgana.combo: Before a fight, charge Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. When Morgana E Black Shield is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Morgana.escape: Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so engage while Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to aim outside its range before the stun. Pantheon W Shield Vault only closes the gap to an enemy, so don’t count on it as a way to retreat.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault once Morgana E Black Shield is down. After engaging, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Morgana to block damage from the front. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in.
Morgana.laning: Keep an angle that lets you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding with minions between you. Chip away at her health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts, and use bushes to find an engage angle when Morgana focuses on last-hitting or right after Morgana Q Dark Binding is down.
Morgana.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, so build a lead with consistent short Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes. As items stack later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early advantage to close out the game.
Morgana.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, close in on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and push in while blocking damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Don’t waste Pantheon W Shield Vault’s stun on a target with Morgana E Black Shield active. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, aim for a visible landing spot and time it with your allies’ crowd control.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks follow, so dodge while keeping minions between you. When low on health, don’t walk over Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If caught by Morgana R Soul Shackles, get out of range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Nami’s damage is mostly magic, so start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Add Executioner’s Calling early so Nami W Ebb and Flow’s healing doesn’t erase kill opportunities during fights.
Nami.combo: Before a fight, charge Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. Engage in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility, so right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Dodge Nami R Tidal Wave to the side, and engage targets affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing after its duration ends. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Nami.fight: Target Nami when Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or after Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing expires. Close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal a quick burst, then face Nami when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Nami.laning: Use bushes and vision to find an approach angle toward Nami. Hold Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at her health, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Nami focuses on last-hitting or right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses.
Nami.phase: Pantheon has strong base stats early, so build a lead in lane by poking with Pantheon Q Comet Spear. As items stack later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Nami.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, close in on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Push in while blocking damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, but don’t engage alone first. Use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to land near your allies at a location with vision, and time it with their crowd control.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but lands slowly, so sidestep when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave also travels slowly, but follow-up combos are dangerous if it hits, so move to the side as soon as you see it. Don’t fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing; wait for its duration to end.

Nasus.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so consider magic resistance if you need to defend against that damage too. Armor is also less effective in Nasus E Spirit Fire’s area, so leave it first.
Nasus.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks before a fight. When Nasus W Wither is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Nasus → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. End Pantheon E Aegis Assault early once there’s no more damage to block.
Nasus.escape: The moment after Nasus W Wither is down is your chance to go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Nasus has no way to create distance besides Flash, but Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support and whether Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active before engaging.
Nasus.fight: Right after Nasus W Wither is down, chip away at his health while he focuses on last-hitting, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Nasus to block damage coming from the front, and end it early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block. Avoid fights without a clear advantage while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus from the start with Pantheon Q Comet Spear so he can’t comfortably last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Pushing the wave under Nasus’s turret makes it easier for him to stack, so let the wave come to you and call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.phase: Nasus stacks up over time while Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so play to avoid letting the game go late.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. Keep your distance and wait out its duration. After your allies land crowd control, lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining a fight with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so don’t engage while affected or move alone within Nasus’s range. Nasus R Fury of the Sands increases his health and defensive stats, so avoid fighting and wait out its duration unless you have a clear advantage in both numbers and damage output. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so don’t stand in its area.

Nautilus.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Nautilus’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Nautilus has relatively high armor, so include penetration when increasing your damage.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, trade in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Nautilus when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Nautilus.escape: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down. Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s root or Nautilus R Depth Charge’s crowd control may follow, so check for allied support before going in. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so create distance from Nautilus’s basic-attack range after the trade.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and trade. Before going in, charge Pantheon P Mortal Will with short Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. If Nautilus uses Nautilus E Riptide right next to you, don’t move hastily until the waves end.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you to watch out for Nautilus Q Dredge Line while chipping away at his health with long Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts. If Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, find an angle from a bush and engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Nautilus focuses on last-hitting. After the trade, immediately get out of range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s basic attack.
Nautilus.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead with consistent short Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes. As items stack later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early gains to close out the game.
Nautilus.teamfight: When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don’t stand on top of your allies along your approach route. After your allies apply crowd control, push in while blocking damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then pin down a key enemy target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in a visible spot in time with your allies.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts an engage and kill opportunity, so dodge it with minions between you. If Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you with his first basic attack, follow-up abilities are easy to land, so don’t remain in basic-attack range after a trade. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand on top of your allies.

Ornn.build: The starting item can’t be determined from the information provided. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your max health, so avoid heavily stacking health alone too.
Ornn.combo: Build your passive with Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks before a fight. When Ornn’s counterattack ability is down, engage in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. End Pantheon E Aegis Assault early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage as soon as Ornn E Searing Charge is down; check whether he can also escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Look to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Ornn W Bellows Breath’s brittle effect ends and his counterattack ability is down, especially before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available again. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging too.
Ornn.fight: Build your passive with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks, then look to trade when Ornn is last-hitting or right after he uses a counterattack ability. Don’t rush in with Pantheon W Shield Vault if Ornn E Searing Charge is still available or he can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, face Ornn to block damage coming from the front.
Ornn.laning: Early on, keep harassing and building your passive with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Use a throw to chip away at his health when he’s too far away to engage. When Ornn focuses on last-hitting and his counterattack ability is down, use the brush to line up Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Ornn tries to craft an item, close in to interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Early on, use Pantheon’s strong base stats and short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to take the lead. Later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability as Ornn’s items and his allies’ masterwork upgrades stack up, so press your early lead to end the game.
Ornn.teamfight: When Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes, sidestep the elemental’s first path and avoid the line where Ornn can send it back. After your allies land crowd control, push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then lock down a key damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them.
Ornn.watch: The pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture acts as a wall that Ornn E Searing Charge can collide with, so stand away from the pillar and terrain walls. If the final breath of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits you and makes you brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends to avoid extra damage and extended crowd control. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes, dodge the elemental to the side and move out of the line between it and Ornn.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone, and don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, trade in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Poppy when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support and Poppy’s counterattack tools before using it.
Poppy.fight: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Before going in, prepare abilities and basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will, and don’t stay in the area left by Poppy Q Hammer Shock. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Poppy to block frontal damage.
Poppy.laning: Harass while building Pantheon P Mortal Will with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When she’s too far away to engage, chip away at her health with a long cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Engage when Poppy focuses on last-hitting and her counterattack ability is down. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, and step on the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador as soon as it lands to prevent her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so pressure the lane and build a lead with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. As items stack up later, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, so use your early lead to end the game.
Poppy.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, close in on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Push forward while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, but wait to engage with a dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to land with your team where you have vision, and move out of Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict’s line when you see her charging it.
Poppy.watch: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault; wait for it to end. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately walk out of the remaining area. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Pyke.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early to reduce the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. Armor helps against Pyke’s damage, but he builds armor penetration, so get health rather than stacking a small amount of armor to stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below. Don’t build magic resistance.
Pyke.combo: After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Pyke, and end it early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block.
Pyke.escape: Don’t engage immediately after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow; check whether Pyke R Death From Below is also available. If Pyke R Death From Below isn’t available yet, close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging too.
Pyke.fight: Chip away at Pyke’s health by throwing Pantheon Q Comet Spear, dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. A good opening to engage is when even Pyke R Death From Below is down. Face Pyke and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block his return damage.
Pyke.laning: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will before a fight with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Use the brush to line up an opening, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down. Keeping vision of Pyke as he retreats after a trade can prevent the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so keep harassing with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and build a lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to end the game.
Pyke.teamfight: Don’t stand beside low-health allies, so Pyke R Death From Below doesn’t hit you both or catch you in an execution chain. After your allies land crowd control, close in on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to take frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them.
Pyke.watch: Pyke E Phantom Undertow leaves a stun along his dash path, so dodge sideways off the path Pyke traveled along. If you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive beneath your feet, you’re already in range, so retreat toward your allies or turret. Watch out for Pyke R Death From Below when your health is low.

Rakan.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Rakan’s damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance, and pick up Executioner’s Calling early to counter the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Rakan.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks before a fight. Immediately after Rakan W Grand Entrance lands, stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then attack in this order: empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Rakan.escape: The moment after you sidestep Rakan W Grand Entrance is your chance to close the gap. If Rakan is separated from his allies, he can’t use Rakan E Battle Dance to reach them, so close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault then.
Rakan.fight: Look for an opening right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, close in and stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault so you can deal damage before he escapes again.
Rakan.laning: Use the brush to line up an opening and chip away at Rakan’s health with a long cast of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Rakan.phase: Pantheon’s base stats are strong early, so keep up the pressure in lane with short casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Rakan.teamfight: Stun Rakan with Pantheon W Shield Vault immediately after Rakan W Grand Entrance lands to prevent him from repositioning. Don’t stand in a line where Rakan R The Quickness can hit several allies at once, and engage on a key target in time with your allies’ crowd control.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing spot in advance, so sidestep as he starts moving to dodge the knock-up. It’s hard to escape on foot while Rakan R The Quickness is active, so use terrain as a barrier or stun him with Pantheon W Shield Vault before he reaches you.

Rell.build: Rell's damage is mostly magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resist, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Rell.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance, then start with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Rell's counterattack ability is down. After landing, use an empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move on to your next action.
Rell.escape: Even if Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down, don't rush your engage while Rell E Full Tilt is still available. Once Rell E Full Tilt is also down and she can't use it again yet, you have an opening to close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check for ally support before engaging.
Rell.fight: Wait outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, then create distance right after Rell dismounts. If Rell E Full Tilt is also down and she can't use it again yet, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault for a short trade. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, face the direction the damage is coming from.
Rell.laning: Use the brush to manage your spacing and charge Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Rell is focused on last-hitting and has just used her counterattack ability. Before trading, use a tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave in basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will.
Rell.phase: Pantheon's base stats are strong early, so build a lead by poking with Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to end the game.
Rell.teamfight: Create space from allies before engaging so several of you aren't pulled in together by Rell R Magnet Storm. After your allies apply crowd control, go in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then lock down a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time your arrival with your allies' crowd control.
Rell.watch: When Rell and an ally speed up together with Rell E Full Tilt, she can engage soon, so stop trading and move beyond the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Even after dodging the knock-up from Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, watch for the stun from Rell Q Shattering Strike, and dodge attacks coming straight at you by moving sideways. Keep your distance from allies before team fights so several of you aren't pulled in together by Rell R Magnet Storm.

Renekton.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek. Prioritize armor against Renekton's main Q, W, and E damage, but armor can't block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus. Against the armor reduction from Renekton E Slice and Dice empowered by Fury, position yourself to dodge the dash rather than stacking more resistances.
Renekton.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance, then attack in this order when Renekton E Slice and Dice is down: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Renekton when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move on to your next action if there's no more damage to block.
Renekton.escape: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Renekton W Ruthless Predator and E Slice and Dice are down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check whether Renekton has used his mobility and where your allies are before pressing it. When backing away after taking his combo, move in a direction with no target for Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit.
Renekton.fight: Trade briefly when Renekton P Reign of Anger is empty. Counterattack after Renekton has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice; especially close the gap with Pantheon W Shield Vault if he used E to disengage. When Renekton R Dominus is active, don't extend the fight; wait for its duration to end.
Renekton.laning: Poke with a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave basic attacks into minions to build Pantheon P Mortal Will before trading. Poke when Renekton steps toward minions to build Fury, but don't stand in or behind the wave and give him a launch point for Renekton E Slice and Dice. After his counterattack ability is down, use the brush to find an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value drops sharply after mid game, so you can gain an advantage by growing without giving him kills. Pantheon also falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to finish the game.
Renekton.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, go in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then lock down an enemy damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot near an ally with vision and time it with your allies' crowd control.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is above half full or nearly there, he can use an empowered ability right away, so stay out of the stun range of Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if the first one hits a unit, so don't stand in or behind a minion wave.

Riven.build: Riven's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build and also get health to reduce the risk of being finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Stun Riven with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after she approaches, then follow with an empowered basic attack. Next, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Riven and finish with a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Riven.escape: The window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back is your chance to engage. Check whether Riven E Valor is also down, and wait until she has used the stun from Riven W Ki Burst before closing in with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Riven.fight: Stun Riven with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after she closes in to interrupt the rest of her combo. Face Riven when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and end it early to move on to your next action if there's no more damage to block.
Riven.laning: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Look for an opening when Riven is last-hitting or has used Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, but don't jump in prematurely with Pantheon W Shield Vault while Riven still has a counterattack ability available.
Riven.phase: Pantheon's base stats are strong early, so use gaps in Riven's abilities to build a lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later as items build, so use the advantage you've created early to finish the game.
Riven.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, close in on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Go in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and time your arrival with your allies when joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall. If Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, don't stay within Riven's range while your health has been reduced.
Riven.watch: Riven can use Riven Q Broken Wings three times in a row to approach, and can close the gap further if Riven E Valor is still available. Back away when you see the first dash, and create distance while Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, watching out for its increased range and damage that scales with missing health.

Rumble.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rumble's damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resist and avoid builds that only stack a lot of health.
Rumble.combo: After the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Rumble while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move on to your next action if there's no more damage to block.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so engage when the movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield is down and Rumble E Electro Harpoon's counterattack is also down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check for ally support before pressing it.
Rumble.fight: Trade briefly after the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends and Rumble E Electro Harpoon's counterattack is down. Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and attack, then take frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Don't stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long.
Rumble.laning: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Use a charged Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at health, and use the brush to find an engage angle while Rumble is focused on last-hitting. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault only right after Rumble's counterattack ability is down.
Rumble.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead through early skirmishes. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to finish the game.
Rumble.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, close in on a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Push in while taking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and when engaging with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with your allies.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is dangerous while you're close, so minimize the time you take damage from it. If you're hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance before the second shot comes. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to take damage, keep facing Rumble.

Senna.build: Get Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Senna's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor; if you also build health, pair it with armor.
Senna.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance by mixing tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks on minions. When engaging, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Senna is fleeing and low on health, save the thrown Pantheon Q Comet Spear to finish her off.
Senna.escape: Right after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is used, you have a chance to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, camouflaged allies may approach together, so check for ally support and nearby vision before going straight into it.
Senna.fight: Before trading, chip away at Senna's health with a charged Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Senna W Last Embrace is down. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so burst her in a short window after closing in. Face Senna and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to take her frontal counterattack damage.
Senna.laning: Watch Senna's soul locations from the start and poke when she steps forward to collect them. Use the brush to find an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault, but engage only after Senna W Last Embrace is down. Avoid the straight path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness while pressuring her with Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Senna.phase: Pantheon's strong base stats let him pressure Senna, who has low health and attack damage, early. In mid game, use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to affect other lanes and grow your early lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, while Senna's range and attack damage grow, so stop her from collecting mist from the start.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back away to a visible area or use Pantheon Q Comet Spear into the mist to deter an approach. Follow your allies' crowd control with Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down Senna, and face her when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot with vision and time it with your allies.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness heals and slows, so get out of the straight line between Senna and a minion. Senna W Last Embrace roots after a delay when it hits, so dodge it from behind a minion, and if it hits, move away from your allies until the mark disappears. After Senna hits you once, back off immediately so she can't gain mist from a second attack.

Seraphine.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine's damage is mostly magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resist, so prioritize magic resist. Get Executioner's Calling early too, so you don't miss a kill opportunity because of the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Seraphine.combo: Before trading, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Seraphine while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move on to your next action if there's no more damage to block.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no mobility and struggles to create distance, but Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check the positions of allied support before engaging.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to engage. Seraphine has no mobility, so close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and burst her briefly. Seraphine can restore health with Seraphine W Surround Sound, so it's good to have Executioner's Calling before trading.
Seraphine.laning: Chip away at her health with a charged Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and look for an engage angle while Seraphine is focused on last-hitting. Approach through the brush, but use Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. If Seraphine is standing alone, separated from an allied ranged carry, that's a chance to trade.
Seraphine.phase: Pressure Seraphine and build a lead while Pantheon's base stats are strong early. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to finish the game.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the left and right so Seraphine R Encore can't gain range by hitting your allies. After your allies apply crowd control, push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then lock down Seraphine with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land in a spot with vision and time it with your allies.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you're slowed, get out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't line up with allies in team fights. When your health is low, also watch out for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on your missing health.

Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Resistances can’t reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so focus on avoiding the center instead of only stacking health. If you can lower his attack speed, that can help reduce the damage from his basic attacks.
Sett.combo: Before trading, stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Once Sett E Facebreaker is down, trade with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Sett, and end it early if there’s no more damage to block.
Sett.escape: The window after Sett R The Show Stopper is down is an opportunity to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Sett E Facebreaker is down too, there’s also less risk of being stunned. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check Sett’s ability to counter and your allies’ positions before engaging.
Sett.fight: After Sett E Facebreaker is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and make a short trade. If you’ve dealt enough damage to strengthen Sett W Haymaker, back away. When you have to stand your ground, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Sett. Sidestep the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: Poke with quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and stack your passive. If he’s too far away to engage, chip away with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for a Pantheon W Shield Vault angle when Sett is focused on last-hitting and Sett E Facebreaker is down. Avoid standing on the opposite side of the minion wave in a position that puts enemies on both sides of Sett.
Sett.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so build a lead by poking with quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability late, so use your early lead to end the game.
Sett.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, pin down an enemy damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and avoid going in alone and getting isolated after Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose an area where you have vision and time your landing with your allies’ crowd control.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after he takes damage, so back away immediately after dealing a large amount of damage, and sidestep the center of its indicator when he casts it. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of him, so don’t stand with Sett between you and the minions. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so position carefully while his R is available.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to deal with the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don't build only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only stack a lot of health.
Shen.combo: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Shen E Shadow Dash has missed and Shen W Spirit's Refuge is down. After landing, use an empowered basic attack, Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then a tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Shen while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early if there's no more damage to block.
Shen.escape: Shen E Shadow Dash is his only mobility ability and his forced crowd control, so engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after it misses. If Shen R Stand United isn't available yet, Shen has fewer ways to get away too. Pantheon W Shield Vault can't be used to escape, so check where your allies can support you before engaging.
Shen.fight: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait on basic attacks and deal ability damage. Face Shen when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage.
Shen.laning: Throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at his health, and look for an engage angle while Shen is focused on last-hitting. Keep up your farming and passive stacks with tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and take lane control. If you push the lane and keep Shen occupied with CS, you can also make him lose out when he uses Shen R Stand United to affect another lane.
Shen.phase: Take control early with Pantheon's strong base stats and tapped Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so make use of your early lead.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join fights with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team if Shen disappears or starts channeling. After your allies apply crowd control, lock down a priority target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land at a spot with vision and time it with your allies.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you're likely to take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash, and also get out of the path of the spirit blade as it returns to Shen. While Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, Pantheon's basic attacks are blocked, so don't rush your empowered attack.

Singed.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Singed’s main damage is magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Singed.combo: Stun Singed with Pantheon W Shield Vault from outside Singed W Mega Adhesive, then use an empowered basic attack, Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and a quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear in that order. Face Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward incoming damage you need to block, and end it early to move on if there’s no more damage to block.
Singed.escape: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Singed W Mega Adhesive is down and there’s no adhesive underfoot. If Singed E Fling is down too, you can engage without risking being thrown, but Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for ally backup before committing.
Singed.fight: Before trading, stack your passive with quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear casts and basic attacks. If Singed runs away while leaving Singed Q Poison Trail, don’t chase through the poison. If you have enough damage to finish him, throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear from within range.
Singed.laning: Poke with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for a Pantheon W Shield Vault angle from the brush when Singed is focused on last-hitting and his counter ability is down. Don’t extend trades by following Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.phase: In the mid game, once Singed has his core items, he becomes harder to kill, so use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to impact other lanes. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability late, so play to end the game with the lead you built early.
Singed.teamfight: When Singed engages, pin him down with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then attack his allies instead of chasing him to the end. Don’t follow Singed Q Poison Trail deep into the fight; block frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault as you reach a key target. Don’t engage alone first. Follow up on your allies’ crowd control, or land Pantheon R Grand Starfall with them in an area where you have vision.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t use movement abilities on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and being hit by Singed E Fling there will also root you, so go around the adhesive. If Singed is facing away from allies, he can use Singed E Fling to throw you into the enemy team, so don’t stand in front of him.

Sion.build: There’s no specific first item for Pantheon in the data, so a purchase order can’t be set. Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. It’s also important to dodge Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor when it hits.
Sion.combo: After stacking Pantheon P Mortal Will, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick press of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Sion W Soul Furnace is active, concentrate this damage before the shield explodes.
Sion.escape: Avoid the charged attack from Sion Q Decimating Smash or make him release it early, and engage when Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check where your allies can support you before engaging.
Sion.fight: Sidestep Sion Q Decimating Smash or make him cast it early, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus damage to break the shield before it explodes. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing Sion to block frontal damage, and end it early when there’s no more damage to block.
Sion.laning: Before trading, stack Pantheon P Mortal Will with quick presses of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Set up an approach from the brush, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault just after Sion uses Sion Q Decimating Smash while focused on last-hitting. If you keep giving Sion CS, his maximum health increases, so disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in other lanes.
Sion.phase: Pantheon can apply strong pressure early with his base stats and quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. In the late game, as items build up, Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability, while Sion gains maximum health through farming, so turn your early advantage into control of the game.
Sion.teamfight: After your allies land crowd control, close in on a key enemy target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block incoming frontal damage as you push in. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a landing spot where you have vision and time it with your allies’ crowd control.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer he charges, as it can knock you up and stun you, so sidestep when you see him charging. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of his approach. Even after taking Sion down, reposition to avoid the attacks from Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Skarner’s main damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Decide ahead of time whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: Stack Pantheon P Mortal Will ahead of time. Once Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, trade with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Skarner with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move on if there’s no more damage to block.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is his only mobility ability, so right after he uses it, you have a window to close the distance with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall. If you have allowed him to land a wall collision with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, he can dash again soon, so back off. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for ally backup before going in.
Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault for a short trade. When Skarner retaliates and deals damage, keep Pantheon E Aegis Assault aimed toward him. Avoid fights where you take empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval for too long.
Skarner.laning: Chip away at Skarner’s health with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and engage when he’s focused on last-hitting or right after he uses Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Before trading, use quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave in basic attacks on minions to stack Pantheon P Mortal Will. Don’t stand with your back to a wall; look for a chance to fight in open space.
Skarner.phase: Take control early with Pantheon’s strong base stats and quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability late, while Skarner’s damage increases with tank items, so use your early lead to end the game.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance from Skarner and his allies, mindful of the short range of Skarner R Impale and its pull through terrain, and don’t stand at the edge of an objective pit. After your allies land crowd control, push in while blocking frontal damage with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then pin down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land with your allies at a spot where you have vision, timing it with them.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if he collides with a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, and that suppression can’t be removed with Pantheon W Shield Vault or a stun, so stay out of its range. Stay outside melee range so you don’t keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Sona.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Sona’s magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Sona W Aria of Perseverance can erase a kill opportunity with its healing during a fight, so buy Executioner’s Calling early.
Sona.combo: After stacking Pantheon P Mortal Will, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault to stun Sona and land an empowered basic attack. Then use Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing her, and if there’s no more damage to block, end it early and finish with a quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Sona.escape: The window to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault is after Sona R Crescendo is down and before she creates distance with Sona E Song of Celerity. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for ally backup and the enemy’s position before using it.
Sona.fight: Look for an engage when Sona steps forward to share her aura or focuses on last-hitting. Stun her first with Pantheon W Shield Vault before she can get away with Sona E Song of Celerity, then deal a burst of damage quickly.
Sona.laning: Poke from early on with quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and weave in basic attacks to stack Pantheon P Mortal Will ahead of time. Set up an approach from the brush and keep trading damage so Sona has to spend mana on healing.
Sona.phase: Sona gets stronger as the game goes on, while Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability late, so use your early advantage to end the game.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so you don’t all get hit by Sona R Crescendo. Follow your allies’ crowd control to close in on Sona with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage and separate her from an allied group. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land with your allies in an area where you have vision.
Sona.watch: If Sona enters basic attack range with Sona P Power Chord ready, watch out for extra damage or a slow and keep your distance. Sona R Crescendo stuns targets in a line, so don’t stand in a line with your allies when Sona steps forward.

Soraka.build: Soraka’s main damage is magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Buy Executioner’s Calling early too, so Soraka’s healing doesn’t erase your kill opportunity.
Soraka.combo: Stack your passive ahead of time with quick casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Once Soraka E Equinox is down, attack with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move on.
Soraka.escape: Soraka has no mobility ability, so the moment Soraka E Equinox is down is an opportunity to engage.
Soraka.fight: Right after Soraka E Equinox is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal a burst of damage quickly. Dodging Soraka Q Starcall helps reduce how often she can heal and create distance. Since Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, check for ally backup before engaging.
Soraka.laning: Chip away at Soraka’s health with long casts of Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and look for a Pantheon W Shield Vault angle from the brush when she’s focused on last-hitting or right after she uses Soraka E Equinox. Pressure your allied ranged damage dealer to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which costs her health. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall to keep up this pressure.
Soraka.phase: Early on, Pantheon’s strong base stats make this the time to apply pressure aggressively. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability late, so use your early lead to end the game.
Soraka.teamfight: Target Soraka, who has no mobility, instead of continually hitting the enemy she heals. After your allies land crowd control, pin her down with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. If you join with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land with your allies at a spot where you have vision, timing it with them.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka hits you with Soraka Q Starcall, she heals and gains movement speed, so dodge it even before you engage. Inside Soraka E Equinox, you are silenced and can be rooted, so engage before stepping into the zone or after the ability is down. Keep Soraka R Wish in mind when looking for a kill, since it heals her allies regardless of distance.

Taric.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand the lane, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Taric’s main damage is magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Pick up Executioner’s Calling early as well to counter the healing from Taric Q Starlight’s Touch.
Taric.combo: Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Taric E Dazzle is down and the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance is not active. Follow up with an empowered attack immediately after landing, then Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and a short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Taric when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there is no more damage to block.
Taric.escape: Dodging Taric E Dazzle creates an opportunity to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Taric has no skill to create distance on his own, but the stun can also come from the linked ally, so check that position first. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Taric.fight: Immediately after dodging Taric E Dazzle sideways, trade briefly. Create distance again so you don’t stay in melee range and keep taking empowered attacks from Taric P Bravado. During Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity, keep him locked down with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then attack when the immunity ends.
Taric.laning: Chip away at his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and look for moments when Taric is focused on last-hitting. Keep your distance until Taric E Dazzle is down, and watch the stun range around the linked ally too. Manage the lane so Taric can’t get close enough to attack a target; this can also delay his ability rotations through Taric P Bravado.
Taric.phase: Pantheon’s base stats are strong early, but Taric also has high armor and damage from Taric P Bravado, so an extended close-range fight can go badly. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Taric.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front, then lock down a key damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity activates, stop attacking and wait it out with a stun such as Pantheon W Shield Vault, then attack again as it ends. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them.
Taric.watch: Dodge Taric E Dazzle by moving sideways when you see it being telegraphed. The stun also triggers from the position of an ally linked by Taric W Bastion, so watch around the linked champion too. Stop attacking when Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity activates, then deal damage again when it ends.

Teemo.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Teemo’s magic damage early. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance before armor.
Teemo.combo: Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and Pantheon P Mortal Will is ready, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Teemo when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart goes down, if Teemo W Move Quick has also been used, it’s a good time to close the distance with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support and your surroundings before engaging.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart goes down. If you’re blinded, deal damage with Pantheon Q Comet Spear instead of basic attacks, or back away. If you decide to engage, avoid a short trade where you get hit by Teemo E Toxic Shot and then retreat; use Pantheon W Shield Vault to stay on him.
Teemo.laning: Chip away at his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault after Teemo focuses on last-hitting and uses Teemo Q Blinding Dart. Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks on minions. Teemo may be invisible in bushes without vision, so check them with a Control Ward or go around.
Teemo.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead quickly. He falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early advantage to close out the game.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow passages as you engage. Land with Pantheon R Grand Starfall in time with your allies’ crowd control, or push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front and lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault. You have no way out after Pantheon W Shield Vault, so don’t engage first by yourself.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so don’t engage while weaving in basic attacks when it’s available. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage from even one basic attack, so stay outside its range if you aren’t ready to commit. Teemo R Noxious Trap is invisible and slows you, so be careful around key paths and narrow passages.

Thresh.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early. Thresh’s ability damage is mostly magic, and Pantheon has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Thresh.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault, land an empowered attack, use Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward the enemy, then finish with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is an opportunity to close the distance, but an escape may still be possible if Thresh W Dark Passage is available. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall in the window when Thresh W Dark Passage has also been used, and avoid positions where Thresh E Flay could pull you toward allies.
Thresh.fight: Dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence sideways, then close the distance and look to trade when Thresh steps forward to collect souls. Using Pantheon W Shield Vault to engage means you can’t use it to escape, so check Thresh W Dark Passage and the positions of nearby allies before going in.
Thresh.laning: Use the bushes to find an approach angle and chip away at his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Thresh Q Death Sentence goes down, when he’s collecting souls or focused on last-hitting.
Thresh.phase: Pantheon’s base stats are strong early, so apply pressure with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and build a lead. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, while Thresh gets tougher as he collects souls, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Thresh.teamfight: After your allies apply crowd control, engage on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault, and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward the incoming damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them. If Thresh W Dark Passage appears to save the target, finish them immediately or back away. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, choose a wall for your toughest ally to break through, then escape together.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence leads into a stun and dash, so move sideways to dodge when you see him raise his hook. When stepping forward to last-hit, change direction once more, and avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you toward them.

Trundle.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early to counter the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute. Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate reduces resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so prioritise getting out of its range over stacking more resistance or health.
Trundle.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you can close in on him outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Trundle when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early if there’s no more damage to block.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Check that the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp and the dangerous window of Trundle R Subjugate have also ended. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before closing in.
Trundle.fight: Back out of Trundle W Frozen Domain and wait out its duration, then trade briefly after Trundle Q Chomp’s attack damage reduction ends. Create distance instead of fighting while Trundle R Subjugate is active and he’s tougher. Before engaging again, build Pantheon P Mortal Will and go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Trundle.laning: Poke with Pantheon Q Comet Spear early, but account for the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute and don’t prolong the lane by gradually chipping away at health. Look for an angle to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault when Trundle is focused on last-hitting and has just used a counterattack skill. If you’ve chipped away at health, press your advantage immediately or push the lane to force a recall.
Trundle.phase: Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Trundle.teamfight: While Trundle R Subjugate is active, target someone else instead of attacking Trundle. Join your allies with Pantheon R Grand Starfall in time with their crowd control, or push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front and lock down an enemy damage dealer with Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces Pantheon’s attack damage, so avoid trading until the effect ends. Don’t fight inside Trundle W Frozen Domain; back out and create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active too. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape, so avoid narrow paths and move sideways immediately if a pillar appears.

Udyr.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling early to counter the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Build armor first for resistances, but keep in mind that armor can’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types and scales with maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Udyr.combo: Start with Pantheon P Mortal Will charged after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and its Awakening has ended. Use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault has no more damage to block, end it early and move to your next action.
Udyr.escape: Look to engage right after making Udyr use E Blazing Stampede, when you’ve already been stunned or his Awakening has ended. You can close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault then, but it can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before using it. Stuns don’t work during Udyr E’s Awakening, so save Pantheon W Shield Vault until it ends.
Udyr.fight: Make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede, then engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal a quick burst of damage. If the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle has been removed, keep up the pressure and don’t give him time to heal. When you need to block a counterattack, face Udyr while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so place vision on key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push up in lane while he’s out of sight. Use short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear to last-hit minions and charge Pantheon P Mortal Will. If Udyr appears, don’t use Pantheon W Shield Vault first; check whether he has used Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.phase: Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, and Udyr also becomes tougher with defensive items, so use your early advantage to close out the game.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; prioritize weaker enemies behind him. After your allies apply crowd control, lock down a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block damage from the front. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with them.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the distance and stuns, so keep your distance right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t fight him for long. Pantheon W Shield Vault’s stun doesn’t work during Udyr E’s Awakening, so use it after the Awakening ends.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, and Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, so build armor first. Pantheon’s main damage is also physical, while Urgot has relatively high armor, so include penetration. Consider your total health for getting out of the execute range of Urgot R Fear Beyond Death rather than just stacking a lot of health.
Urgot.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Urgot E Disdain is down, trade with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Urgot → short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If there’s no more damage to block, end Pantheon E Aegis Assault early and create distance.
Urgot.escape: Right after Urgot E Disdain goes down is your window to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault only lets you engage on an enemy, so check for allied support and Urgot’s counterattack options before going in. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you, it’s hard to walk away; use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to get out if needed.
Urgot.fight: Urgot P Echoing Flames damage builds up if you stay near him too long, so trade briefly and fully retreat beyond its short range. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Urgot E Disdain goes down. When you need to block a counterattack, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Urgot.
Urgot.laning: Chip away at his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and look for an angle to engage when Urgot is focused on last-hitting. Approach through the bushes, but don’t engage first with Pantheon W Shield Vault before Urgot E Disdain is down. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk out of its range.
Urgot.phase: Pantheon’s base stats are strong early, so create opportunities by poking with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so allies can reduce his engage angles by grouping together. After your allies apply crowd control, engage on a key target with Pantheon W Shield Vault and block damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, choose a location where you have vision and time your landing with your allies’ crowd control.
Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain dashes in and stuns, so use the moment right after it goes down to engage.
