Urgot Q Corrosive Charge heavily slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to dodge it as it flies toward you. If you’re hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get out of range before your health reaches the execute threshold.

Velkoz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early. Vel’Koz’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and R Life Form Disintegration Ray deal true damage that resistance can’t block, so avoid taking consecutive hits from his skills.
Velkoz.combo: Once Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Vel’Koz when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block. If Vel’Koz moves away but is still within range at low health, throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear to finish him.
Velkoz.escape: Vel’Koz has no mobility skill, so the key engage window is right after Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption goes down. Close the distance then with Pantheon W Shield Vault or R Grand Starfall. Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock away enemies who get very close, so keep Pantheon Q Comet Spear ready to finish him before engaging.
Velkoz.fight: Right after Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption goes down, look for an opportunity to engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault and deal brief damage. Vel’Koz has no mobility skill, but Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging. When damage is coming from the front, aim Pantheon E Aegis Assault toward Vel’Koz.
Velkoz.laning: Chip away at Vel’Koz’s health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then look for an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault after Vel’Koz focuses on last-hitting and uses E Tectonic Disruption. Approach through the bushes, and watch for and dodge even the split beams from Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission. Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks.
Velkoz.phase: Use Pantheon’s base stats and short-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear to lead the poking and fighting early. Pantheon falls behind in damage and durability later, so use your early lead to close out the game.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize stunning him with Pantheon W Shield Vault to interrupt the beam. Engage on Vel’Koz after your allies apply crowd control, and block damage from the front with Pantheon E Aegis Assault while facing him. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, land where your allies have vision and time your arrival with their crowd control.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission can split, so dodge the branching beam too: don’t just move sideways; move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the beam passed. Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks you up, and if consecutive hits complete the stacks of Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction, you take true damage, so back away and wait it out when you get stacks. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, look for an opportunity to interrupt it with the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault.

Volibear.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of choices that add a lot of health alone.
Volibear.combo: If Volibear’s counterattack ability is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault to stun him, then land an empowered basic attack with Pantheon P Mortal Will. Next, face Volibear and use Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then finish with a quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Volibear runs and is low on health, save the throw of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to finish him.
Volibear.escape: Go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault while both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are down. In particular, look for a chance before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up; you can also close the distance then with Pantheon R Grand Starfall. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Volibear.fight: Keep your distance while Volibear Q Thundering Smash is active, and move to the side when you see the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter. After Volibear’s counterattack ability is down and his passive stacks have fallen off, build Pantheon P Mortal Will and attack briefly. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, face Volibear to block the incoming damage.
Volibear.laning: Poke with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will. If Volibear approaches while hitting minions to build passive stacks, avoid fighting; look for an opening after the stacks fall off, while he focuses on last-hitting. Approach through brush, but use Pantheon W Shield Vault only after Volibear’s counterattack ability is down.
Volibear.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so build a lead with brief Pantheon Q Comet Spear pokes. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind later as items accumulate, so use your early lead to end the game.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has built passive stacks by hitting minions or monsters, avoid fighting him in that state. After allied crowd control lands, advance with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, then use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down a key target. If your health is low while Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under the turret; retreat deep into your side.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear Q Thundering Smash is active and he approaches, watch for the stun from his empowered basic attack and let its duration run out from outside his attack range. When you see the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Volibear W Frenzied Maul can restore his health, so don’t prolong a fight you can’t finish.

Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance over armor.
Xerath.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault to land an empowered basic attack, follow with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, then use a quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is when Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before going in.
Xerath.fight: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Dodge to the side and close the distance while Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse; once you’re close, face Xerath with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage.
Xerath.laning: Use brush to set up an opening, and throw Pantheon Q Comet Spear to chip away at his health when you’re too far away to engage. Farm while avoiding heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath has spent a lot of mana.
Xerath.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so poke with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and create opportunities.
Xerath.teamfight: After allied crowd control lands, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to close in on a key target, then face the enemy with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, coordinate your timing with allies and land where you have vision.
Xerath.watch: Be especially careful of the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb, as it can lead to follow-up damage.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Also account for the fact that armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Attack speed slows also delay how soon Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado returns.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first and build Pantheon P Mortal Will. When engaging, use Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Yasuo when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action once there’s no more damage to block.
Yasuo.escape: The chance to go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault comes right after Yasuo throws Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t engage just because he used it once; check whether there are minions for him to dash through. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, close the distance in time with allied crowd control using Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Yasuo.fight: Use Pantheon Q Comet Spear to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before starting a trade. Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down, check Yasuo’s counterattack ability and the nearby minions, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault. When using Pantheon E Aegis Assault, face Yasuo to block damage coming from the front.
Yasuo.laning: Poke with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks to build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance. Keeping the wave thin on your side leaves Yasuo fewer minions to dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, making it easier to prevent his approach. When Yasuo focuses on last-hitting and has used his tornado, use brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, use Pantheon’s high base stats and quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind later as items accumulate, so play to end the game with the lead you built earlier.
Yasuo.teamfight: After allied crowd control lands, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to close in on a key target. Push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage, and end it early once there’s no more damage to block. Use Pantheon R Grand Starfall to a point where you have vision, coordinating its timing with allies.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after hitting twice, so move to the side to dodge when its stacks are full. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade closes the distance by dashing through minions, so watch the positions of nearby minions too. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is available, change your angle for throwing Pantheon Q Comet Spear or save it until the wall disappears.

Yone.combo: If Yone’s tornado isn’t ready and his counterattack ability is down, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault, then use an empowered basic attack, Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and a quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear in that order. If Yone goes in first with Yone E Soul Unbound, save Pantheon W Shield Vault to stun him and stop his return. End Pantheon E Aegis Assault early and move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Yone.escape: The chance to engage comes when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado isn’t ready and Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are down. If only one mobility ability is down, Yone can escape with the other, so don’t rush to use Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check the enemy’s mobility abilities and allied support before going in.
Yone.fight: Don’t go in first with Pantheon W Shield Vault while Yone’s tornado is ready. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, use the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault to stop his return. Against damage Yone deals from the front, face him while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Trade briefly right after Yone’s counterattack ability is down.
Yone.laning: Prepare your empowerment with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. When Yone is focused on last-hitting and has just used his counterattack ability, set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Yone’s tornado is ready, wait outside its range for the stacks to disappear.
Yone.phase: Pantheon is strong early, while Yone is weak before he gains attack speed, so build a lead in health and CS. Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind later as items accumulate, so play to end the game using the advantage you gained early.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and check the backline that Yone R Fate Sealed can target. If Yone goes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with the stun from Pantheon W Shield Vault. Don’t go in alone; engage in time with allied crowd control, and choose a landing point with vision when joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. After Yone goes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, extra damage may occur when he returns, so if health has decreased, get out of range before he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits, so check your position and the backline before a team fight.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks. Yorick Q Last Rites heals him, so get Executioner's Calling early. Avoid choices that only add health, considering the max-health-based damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Yorick.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance, then trade in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Face Yorick with Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and end it early to move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and go in during the window when Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Pantheon W Shield Vault is an engage ability that closes in on the enemy, so you can’t use it to escape; check the Mist Walkers and allied support positions before going in.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, then close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault after Yorick W Dark Procession is down, where there are few Mist Walkers and no pile of graves. Before engaging, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Face Yorick when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Yorick.laning: Don’t fight where many graves have accumulated near Yorick; push the lane so minions die under the enemy turret. Poke with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault when Yorick is focused on last-hitting and Yorick E Mourning Mist is down.
Yorick.phase: Pantheon is strongest early, so make short trades and build a lead when Yorick has few graves and Mist Walkers.
Yorick.teamfight: After allied crowd control lands, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to lock down the enemy’s key damage dealer, then push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, coordinate your timing with allies and land where you have vision.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you, and deals damage based on your max health, so watch the ball’s trajectory and dodge it. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it, and create distance from Yorick when the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you.

Zilean.build: Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance. Also get Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Zilean R Chronoshift.
Zilean.combo: Before fighting, build Pantheon P Mortal Will with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Once Zilean’s counterattack ability is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. If Zilean moves away and is low on health, finish him with the throw of Pantheon Q Comet Spear.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so go in when Zilean E Time Warp is down or right after you avoid the stun threat from two Zilean Q Time Bombs. Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape, so check for allied support before engaging.
Zilean.fight: Close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault and burst briefly right after Zilean’s counterattack ability is down. When damage comes from the front, face Zilean while using Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Don’t unload your abilities on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift; look for an opening when its duration ends or right after they revive.
Zilean.laning: Chip away at his health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, then use brush to set up an angle for Pantheon W Shield Vault when Zilean is focused on last-hitting and his counterattack ability has just gone down.
Zilean.phase: Pantheon’s damage and durability fall behind later, so play to end the game using the lead you built early.
Zilean.teamfight: After allied crowd control lands, use Pantheon W Shield Vault to close in on a key target, then push in with Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage. If the enemy damage dealer is affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, target the fragile Zilean first. When joining with Pantheon R Grand Starfall, coordinate your timing with allies and land where you have vision.
Zilean.watch: If two Zilean Q Time Bombs attach, they stun, so move away from allies as soon as the first bomb attaches and get outside the blast radius. If you’re caught by the slow from Zilean E Time Warp, you can easily get hit by the bomb combo, so don’t engage alone while this ability is available.

Zyra.build: Zyra’s damage is mostly magic, and Pantheon’s magic resistance is on the low side, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Zyra.combo: Build Pantheon P Mortal Will in advance with quick taps of Pantheon Q Comet Spear and basic attacks. Once Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, attack in this order: Pantheon W Shield Vault → empowered basic attack → Pantheon E Aegis Assault → quick tap of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. End Pantheon E Aegis Assault early and move to your next action if there’s no more damage to block.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no mobility, so the chance to go in comes right after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots to the side. If Zyra R Stranglethorns is placed, walk out of its area before you’re knocked up, and save Pantheon R Grand Starfall as a way out if needed. Don’t count Pantheon W Shield Vault as an escape, since it closes in on the enemy.
Zyra.fight: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, close in with Pantheon W Shield Vault when there are no plants nearby. Zyra has no mobility, but Pantheon W Shield Vault can’t be used to escape either, so check for allied support before going in. Face Zyra when using Pantheon E Aegis Assault to block frontal damage.
Zyra.laning: Chip away at her health with long-range Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and look for an opening when Zyra focuses on last-hitting. Approach using brush, but go in with Pantheon W Shield Vault only right after Zyra E Grasping Roots is down. Step on seeds along the way to remove them; if Zyra tries to grow them with an ability, dodge backward, then step on them again.
